text: A strip of masking tape makes a handy temporary label for freezer containers: write the contents and date on it, then peel it off cleanly when the tub is empty.
A bicycle dynamo turns the wheel’s motion into electricity for its lights; a simple bit of engineering can make an ordinary journey safer without batteries.
Use two minutes to search your email for “unsubscribe”, then remove yourself from one mailing list you no longer read; most inboxes make this easy from a message.
